text: 在重庆举行的“2026中国摩托车重庆论坛”上，重庆市经济和信息化委员会副主任王含介绍，近年来，重庆聚力打造“33618”现代制造业集群体系，全力构建重庆摩托车一小时产业圈。全市摩托车产业呈现出结构优化、向新向上的良好态势。
text_en: At the "2026 China Motorcycle Chongqing Forum" held in Chongqing, Wang Han, deputy director of the Chongqing Municipal Commission of Economy and Information Technology, introduced that in recent years Chongqing has focused on building the "33618" modern manufacturing cluster system and making every effort to build Chongqing's one-hour motorcycle industry circle. The city's motorcycle industry has shown a sound trend of structural optimization and upward development toward new areas.
